## Summary of Changes

A concise explanation of the changes, bug fixes, or optimizations introduced in this pull request.

## Motivation & Context

- What problem or resource constraint does it solve for users on free-tier compute (Colab/Kaggle)?
- Related issue: Fixes # (issue number)
